notes.title: Full release on February! 2月23日フルリリース！
notes.content:
We are finally releasing the full version of “School of Talent: SUZU ROUTE”! It will be released on February 23, 2017. As of now, the price of the Early Access version has risen, so we advise you to purchase after the full release.

Differences with Early Access version are as follows:
1. Addition of Language Option tabs. Two languages out of Japanese, English, Chinese, or Portuguese can be displayed simultaneously.
2. Addition of opening and ending movies.
3. Increase in number of illustrations.
4. Addition of BGM gallery.
5. Soundtrack purchasable as DLC(coming soon).
6. Optimization in effects.
7. Glitches fixed.
8. Increase in price.
9. Addition of Trading card function(coming soon).

In about half an hour from now, We will launch full version!

In releasing this full version, we truly want to thank those who have supported us from Greenlight and Early Access.

We would never have gotten this far without all the comments and feedback.

We sincerely hope you enjoy“School of Talent: SUZU ROUTE”!
